svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 1,200 x 1,200 mm blank with the flutes running up the panel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rout a flat-bottomed groove 13.6 mm wide on the back face at 600 mm, through the back skin and ribs, front skin whole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hot-punch eight 8 mm holes 12.5 mm from each side edge at 125, 175, 1,025, 1,075 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heat-seal every cut edge 2 mm deep, the groove shoulders and ends too (rules E1, E2)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print side is the front: zone signs at least 25 mm from holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stands folded 30 deg at the groove (zigzag, rule S1); edges slide 40 mm into the clip slots until the pegs click

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: folds flat to 180 deg and 90 deg the other way without a crack in the front skin
